tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the chart plate, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tiles inside a card, selected rows, the active nav tab, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of secondary and ghost buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, chart grid, input borders.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Inactive stepper dots, slider tracks, the off switch track, scrollbar thumbs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and readouts on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, hints, units, axis text, the drum speed slider. Passes 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: heat
tokens.usage: Ember. Temperature: the live curve, temperature readouts, Manual badge text.

tokens.name: heat-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the heater slider. Always with on-heat text.

tokens.name: heat-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: heat-tint
tokens.usage: Manual badge and coach card backgrounds; the chosen option of a toggle, segmented control or switch.

tokens.name: on-heat
tokens.usage: Text and icons on heat-fill (6.9:1).

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: Cyan. Airflow and rate of rise: RoR line and readout, fan slider, Auto badge text.

tokens.name: air-tint
tokens.usage: Auto badge background.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: The profile target curve, drawn dashed. Never for text.

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: Ghost roast lines and markers on the chart. Never for text.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Connected status, completed steps, on-target deltas.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stalled temperature, low stock.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Emergency stop fill and safety-trip borders. Always with on-critical text.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text and icons on critical (4.7:1).

tokens.name: critical-text
tokens.usage: Safety messages and the drop-temp line label.

tokens.name: critical-surface
tokens.usage: Background of safety banners.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive element, 2px with 2px offset.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: Live values in stat cards. Always tabular numerals.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Summary values, profile key settings, output percentages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the current phase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Press First crack when you hear it.
styles.usage: Hints and table text. One line wherever possible.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels above values, axis text, legends.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside badges, between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a value and its unit or label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding; gap between header and content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: All buttons, inputs, nav tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: List cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, stepper dots.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: small buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Secondary actions such as Drop now.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The one primary action per phase.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the shared sidebar on History, Beans, Profiles, Roasters and Settings.
